definition: bad-tempered and unfriendly

definition: to walk or behave in a confident, arrogant way

definition: having or showing sensitivity in dealing with others

definition: an object thought to have magical powers

definition: delaying or late

definition: using money and other resources carefully

definition: lacking courage or confidence

definition: severe physical or mental suffering

definition: a slight shaking or trembling movement

definition: cruel and oppressive government or rule

definition: to confirm or support which has been questioned

definition: showing courage or determination
